name: BattlePresentation_RunPairedUnitTransition
domain: Runs the paired-unit action presentation selected by BattlePresentation_RunAction, including side visibility, living-unit compaction, transition context construction, blend ramps, and sprite restoration.
expressed: validates both actor and target unit identifiers and returns -1 on either invalid record
selects transition direction from the actor side and waits for the initial presentation setup
temporarily hides every sprite on the target side while preserving the actor presentation
compacts the living units on the target side and builds the 0x54-byte presentation context
runs the context transition and symmetric sixteen-frame blend ramps
restores the target-side sprites and returns zero after the presentation delay
notes: Independent object analysis bounds the owner at 632 executable bytes; the larger address gap before the next retained assembly file is not an owner extent.

The 10,000-candidate search reduced structural rows from 114 to 88 but never improved the 306-halfword byte delta; its generated best remained 16 bytes short and required accumulated synthetic mutations, so it was rejected.
